Jim Estall has produced some useful times on the road this winter. He placed 6th in the Canterbury 10 miles in 52:17 on January 26th, 9th in the Watford Half-Marathon in 70:10 on February 2nd, and followed this with 7th in the Woking '10' in 51:39 on March 1st.
